summary: Select upgrade packages from verified private construction manifests.
details: The generic upgrade selector delegates versioned construction manifests to the existing independent candidate reader, then requires the exact frozen archive path and target. Final release manifests retain their existing codec and package checks.

The actual nine 4.2.CCC01 archives reproduced the prior format rejection. The corrected selector accepted all nine and rejected a wrong target without copying archives or launching Factorio. Current-source drift guards remain enforced; construction is not gameplay qualification.
